h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kottayam

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kottayam

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Kottayam

c: Kottayam has a long tradition of schools and colleges, and many of them sit on green campuses with room for a walking loop. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Kottayam for these campuses, along with residents' associations and local bodies. Our Fun Fitness machines are made in Vasai, about 1160 km from Kottayam, and come down by road to be installed on site.

Central Kerala gets long spells of rain, and the rolling ground around Kottayam's rubber estates means many sites slope. Water runs off quickly, but soil can wash out from around footings. We suggest grouting each machine into concrete with a small apron around it. Kerala also has many active senior citizens, so a set that mixes gentle machines with a few stronger ones serves the whole campus.

facts.value: About 1,160 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can outdoor gym equipment be installed on sloping campus ground?
items.a: Yes. We grout each machine into a level concrete footing and mark the clear space on the layout. Share photos and rough measurements, and we will suggest where each station should sit.

items.q: Which machines suit senior citizens in a residents' association?
items.a: Tai chi wheels, seated twisters and walkers are the easiest to start on. They use the person's own body weight and need no settings or added weights, so anyone can try them.

items.q: Do you send equipment from Vasai to Kottayam?
items.a: Yes. Everything is made at our Vasai factory and sent by road. Our installation team or a dealer in south India then fixes it on site, grouted or self-standing as the ground needs.
